name: Agriculture
blurb: Crop type, field boundaries, and condition from field to national scale.
useCase: A food-security analyst mapping cropland to target aid before a lean season.

name: Disasters
blurb: Event extent in the days after it happens — what burned, what flooded, what was hit.
useCase: A response team scoping burn scar and flood extent in the first 48 hours, to direct crews.

name: Water & Flooding
blurb: Where water is and how far it has spread — inundation extent, open water, and ice margins.
useCase: A flood analyst delineating inundation extent from SAR in the hours after a storm, through cloud.

name: Forests & Biodiversity
blurb: Composition and change in wooded ecosystems — which species, which crowns, and what drove the loss.
useCase: A forest ecologist separating species in a mixed stand and attributing canopy loss to its driver.

name: Land Cover & Land Use
blurb: General-purpose land cover and land use, where the classes span many applications at once.
useCase: An analyst needing a base map of what is on the ground before narrowing to one sector.

name: Humanitarian & Development
blurb: Proxies for poverty, informal activity, and human wellbeing.
useCase: An NGO locating brick kilns as an indicator of bonded labour.

name: Infrastructure
blurb: The built environment and how it changes — footprints, facilities, and new construction.
useCase: A planner updating a building footprint layer and flagging what has been built since the last pass.

name: Maritime
blurb: Vessels, marine debris, and coastal monitoring.
useCase: A fisheries agency flagging dark vessels and drifting debris.

name: Defense & Security
blurb: Finding and identifying objects — vehicles, aircraft, vessels, installations.
useCase: An analyst detecting aircraft or new installations across wide areas.

name: Climate, Carbon & Energy
blurb: Cryosphere, emissions proxies, and renewable-energy assets.
useCase: A climate-finance team siting solar and tracking glacier retreat.
